parameters.name: AlertLevel
parameters.description:
The alert notification level. Valid values:

- 0: no alert

- 1: reminder

- 2: suspicious

- 3: high-risk.

parameters.name: ExcludeIdList
parameters.description: The list of excluded rule IDs.

parameters.name: Platform
parameters.description:
The operating system type. Valid values:

- **windows**: Windows
- **linux**: Linux.

parameters.name: RuleAction
parameters.description:
The rule action. Valid values:

- **block**: Block.

- **monitor**: Monitor.

- **pass**: Allow.

parameters.name: SelectAll
parameters.description: Specifies whether to select all rules.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The policy status. Valid values:
- **0**: disabled.
- **1**: enabled.
